title: The Last Ledger Anew
author: E. M. Sandoval
blurb: Astrid Marchetti, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
